ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a low white-to-black pixel ratio of approximately 0.10:1. High contrast is localized to white scars and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black pigmentation covering >90% of the fluke. High-intensity white pixels are mapped as discrete circular rings and linear segments scattered across both lobes, with dense clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 105 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge shows low-amplitude, low-frequency irregularities. Distal tips exhibit high-frequency, jagged pixel protrusions due to calcified barnacle clusters extending beyond the biological margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe leading edges follow a distinct convex curve from the central peduncle region towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white rings (barnacle attachment scars) are detected: approximately 12 distinct rings on the right lobe and 5 on the left lobe, ranging from 10 to 25 pixels in diameter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several high-intensity white linear disruptions; a prominent diagonal mark on the upper-left lobe and a series of shorter, unaligned vertical scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive epibiotic (barnacle) colonization at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, creating irregular geometric protrusions from the natural fluke edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive white 'O-shaped' circular scar rings distributed across the dark ventral field, providing unique spatial coordinates for identification.
